name: Sakurako
source:
A princess who is third in line to the imperial throne. She is commonly known as Rose House Lord.

She has been smart since she was a child, and has read many of her books, so she has a lot of knowledge, and she is well aware of the filthiness of adults who approach her. Because of this, she doesn't open up to anyone and she is very difficult. She is foul-mouthed and mean, and even her servants fear her.

However, she is actually a kind girl who cares about others; She just doesn't know how to treat people.
